result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but one clear layout defect stands out: in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is vertically offset from its neighbors, breaking the row alignment.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is pushed down by roughly 25–30px compared to the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards. Its image, delivery-time badge, title, and delivery fee all sit lower than the neighbors, producing a visibly ragged, misaligned row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all carousel items share the same top alignment (e.g., align-items: flex-start on the row container, remove any stray top margin/padding on that card, and enforce a fixed image height for all cards).
